description: Every swap route Mark supports (BTC from Lightning or Arkade into USDC or USDT0 on Arbitrum and back, plus Lightning ↔ Arkade) with Satora's live min/max sats. Fees depend on the route and are shown on the live quote. Lightning or Arkade to USDC or USDT0 (and back) is about 1% total (Satora ~0.5% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Lightning to Arkade is about 0.65% total (Satora ~0.15% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Arkade to Lightning is about 0.80% total (Satora ~0.30% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. When Satora can be reached each route also shows the live pair rate. Read-only: nothing is created. Limits are "unavailable" if Satora cannot be reached
name: swap_routes
